title: Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A salaryman is reborn as Leon, a minor noble 'mob' character in an otome game world where noblewomen hold power over men (to verify). Using his memory of the game and the ancient AI ship Luxion, he sets out to live quietly but ends up humiliating the game's pampered princes, defending the heroine Olivia and the 'villainess' Angelica, and fighting in airship wars (to verify).
life_message: It holds up cynical common sense, loyalty to a few true friends and using power reluctantly to protect them.
